name: Discover CLAUDE.md Files

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Run daily at midnight UTC
  watch:
    types: [started]

jobs:
  discover-claude-files:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install requests

      - name: Search for CLAUDE.md files
        id: search-for-claude-files
        run: |
          import os
          import requests
          from urllib.parse import urlparse

          GITHUB_TOKEN = '${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}'
          REPO_URL = 'https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=filename:CLAUDE.md+language:markdown&sort=updated&order=desc'

          headers = {
              'Authorization': f'token {GITHUB_TOKEN}',
              'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'
          }

          response = requests.get(REPO_URL, headers=headers)
          if response.status_code == 200:
              data = response.json()
              for item in data['items']:
                  repo_url = item['html_url']
                  repo_name = item['full_name']
                  print(f'Found CLAUDE.md in {repo_name}: {repo_url}')
                  with open('claude_files.txt', 'a') as f:
                      f.write(f'{repo_name} - {repo_url}\n')
          else:
              print(f'Failed to fetch repositories: {response.status_code}')

      - name: Check for new CLAUDE.md files
        id: check-new-files
        run: |
          if [ -f claude_files.txt ]; then
              NEW_FILES=$(git diff HEAD^ HEAD --name-only | grep 'claude_files.txt')
              if [ -n "$NEW_FILES" ]; then
                  echo "New CLAUDE.md files found."
                  cat claude_files.txt
              else
                  echo "No new CLAUDE.md files found."
              fi
          else
              echo "claude_files.txt not found."
          fi

      - name: Create issue for new CLAUDE.md files
        if: steps.check-new-files.outputs.NEW_FILES_FOUND == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-issue@v2
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          title: 'New CLAUDE.md Files Found'
          body: |
            The following CLAUDE.md files have been discovered:
